description: Run CloudOps database migrations and deploy a SHA-tagged API image to Kubernetes

runCommand:
cat > /tmp/cloudops-migration-job.yaml <<EOF
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: ${JOB_NAME}
  namespace: cloudops
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 300
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: db-migration
          image: ${IMAGE_URI}
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["alembic"]
          args: ["upgrade", "head"]
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
            - name: DB_HOST
              value: "postgres"
            - name: DB_PORT
              value: "5432"
EOF
"${KUBECTL}" --kubeconfig /root/.kube/config -n cloudops set env deployment/cloudops-api --from=secret/postgres-secret DB_HOST=postgres DB_PORT=5432
